headline: Vitória lost their goalkeeper — and are still favourites
summary: Vitória SC host Marítimo on Friday without goalkeeper Juan Castillo, out for up to six weeks with an ankle injury; defender Francisco Dias is also out for that period. That explains why the market eased Vitória's goal advantage from 1.0 to 0.87. Even so, 10 bookmakers make them 59.5% favourites, because they created 2.48 expected goals at home to Casa Pia and Marítimo average only 0.48 per game. Vitória sit 15th with 5 points, so the price rests on chances rather than the table.
read: Vitória SC host Marítimo on Friday night as clear favourites at 59.5%, even though they sit 15th with five points from eight games. The visitors have averaged just 0.48 expected goals per game, and the market has eased Vitória's handicap from -1.0 to -0.87 after goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias were ruled out for up to six weeks.

facts.fact: Vitória SC are 59.5% to win at home, more than three and a half times Marítimo's 16.4%.
facts.meaning: The home side is a clear favourite for Friday night's opener, with the draw at 24.1%.

facts.fact: Vitória confirmed goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias have sprained ankles/ligaments and will be out for up to six weeks.
facts.meaning: Two players are removed from the squad for the visit of Marítimo and the weeks after it.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 handicap for Vitória has slipped from -1.0 goals to -0.87 in recent days.
facts.meaning: Vitória are still rated nearly a goal better, but by less than a week ago.

facts.fact: Marítimo have averaged just 0.48 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They create almost nothing, which is why the goals line has been falling.

facts.fact: Over 2.5 goals has dropped from 51.3% to 48.2%, so the market now leans under.
facts.meaning: Fewer than three goals is now the more likely outcome on the main line.

facts.fact: Vitória created 2.48 expected goals at home to Casa Pia last month and drew 0-0.
facts.meaning: Chances are being made even while results stall — one reason the market keeps them favoured.

facts.fact: Vitória sit 15th with five points from eight league games, below Marítimo's 11th place on eight points.
facts.meaning: The favourite is the lower-placed team — this is a meeting of two sides on poor league runs.

facts.fact: A Vitória player with eight appearances this season is in doubt for the Marítimo match, according to Notícias ao Minuto.
facts.meaning: A regular in the rotation may join an already shortened squad.

sources.fact: Vitória SC confirmed that goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias have suffered sprains and will be out for up to six weeks.
Vitória SC do not count on goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias for the upcoming matches.
A Vitória SC player with eight appearances this season is in doubt for the reception to Marítimo, according to Notícias ao Minuto.
Vitória SC beat fifth-tier Lamelas 1-0 to advance to the fourth round of the Taça de Portugal.
The match against Marítimo opens the ninth round of the I Liga and kicks off at 20:45 on Friday.
Vitória SC are offering companion tickets for the Marítimo match at 10 euros, up to two per member card.
Marítimo are involved in the ninth-round I Liga fixture against Vitória SC, with Diogo Rosa appointed as referee.
